# App Store

> > Apple's official App Store platform for discovering and downloading apps across iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Vision Pro devices.

The App Store serves as Apple's digital distribution platform, featuring millions of applications including popular apps like ChatGPT, TikTok, YouTube, Duolingo, and streaming services like HBO Max and Paramount+. It provides app rankings, charts, curated collections, and developer pages across multiple regional storefronts.

## Key Topics

- iPhone apps
- iPad apps
- App Store charts and rankings
- iOS apps
- Apple Vision Pro apps
- Mac apps
- Featured apps and collections
- Apple developer programs
- First-party Apple apps
- Popular apps: ChatGPT, TikTok, YouTube, Duolingo
- Streaming services: HBO Max, Paramount+
- Social apps: Tinder, Bumble, Hinge
- Creative tools: CapCut, VSCO
- App categories and directories

## App Discovery and Charts

- [Apps for iPhone - App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/iphone/apps): Main iPhone app directory featuring VSCO, Pok Pok & Apple Vision Pro apps
- [iPhone Top Games & Apps - App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/iphone/charts): Top iPhone apps chart featuring ChatGPT, Claude & Google Gemini rankings
- [iPad Top Games & Apps - App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/ipad/charts): Top iPad apps chart with Disney+, ChatGPT, Netflix & Duolingo rankings
- [Apps for iPhone - App Store (Canada)](https://apps.apple.com/ca/iphone/apps): Canadian iPhone app directory featuring Crave, Motra & Apple Vision Pro

## Apple Developer Apps

- [Apple for iPhone - App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/developer/apple/id284417353?mt=12): Apple's first-party apps including Apple Games, Preview & Pixelmator Pro

## Featured Applications

- [Marshall Verify - App Store](https://apps.apple.com/ru/app/marshall-verify/id6749448971): Marshall Group authenticity verification app using ValiGate QR scanning
- [Buck VPN - App Store](https://apps.apple.com/ru/app/впн-супер-buck-vpn/id6758261727): Buck VPN by BRIGHTWAVE offering privacy protection & network encryption
- [App Meera: your friend locator - App Store](https://apps.apple.com/py/app/noomeera-номера/id583704287?l=ru): Meera friend locator app with live location sharing & geo-social features

## Optional

- [Clock Screensavers - App Store](https://apps.apple.com/ru/app/заставки-с-часами-живое-время/id1597039022?mt=12): Mac clock screensaver app with flip clock & analog clock live wallpapers
- [Audio Recording App - App Store](https://apps.apple.com/ru/app/апож/id6752290977): Audio recording app by Stanislav Ponamorenko with reverse playback effects
- [Add text to lock screen - App Store](https://apps.apple.com/ru/app/add-text-to-lock-screen/id6752535063): iPhone lock screen text customization utility by Tyler Tirapelle (iOS 18)
